The doc states `0c799756b1` and `ffb3f3cc` share DeckGLMap blob `08e692a9d6ff…`, so the baseline is the same source. #1900 is reported as merged on November 14 (`92ff943dfc`), which backs the UX-076 reconciliation. The packaged-acceptance caveat is kept.
